main_subject.description: An adult man with a calm self-assured expression and short dark hair, seated on a parked unbranded cruiser motorcycle.
main_subject.wardrobe: A dark oversized T-shirt, loose wide-leg dark denim, plain high-top sneakers, and minimal unbranded metal jewelry.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Both feet firmly on the ground beside the parked motorcycle, hands resting on the handlebars, looking toward camera.

composition_elements.setting: Quiet urban curb outside a generic glass-front café with abstract window reflections and no customers identifiable.
composition_elements.framing: Full-body upright portrait; motorcycle stationary and positioned safely off the traffic lane.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No motorcycle badge, café typography, license plate text, shoe logo, or readable signs.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft natural overcast light with restrained high-contrast teal-gray grade.
lighting_and_atmosphere.mood: Gritty, composed, and cinematic rather than reckless.

technical_specs.rendering: Fine grain, matte texture, accurate motorcycle geometry, realistic hands, and natural facial detail.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 2:3 vertical 35mm urban film portrait of an adult man with short dark hair and a calm self-assured expression, seated on a stationary unbranded black cruiser motorcycle at a quiet curb. He wears a dark oversized T-shirt, loose wide-leg dark denim, plain high-top sneakers, and minimal unbranded metal jewelry. Keep both feet firmly on the ground and his hands resting on the handlebars. Place him outside a generic glass-front café with abstract reflections and no identifiable customers. Use soft overcast light, restrained teal-gray grade, gritty matte texture, fine grain, accurate motorcycle geometry, realistic hands, and natural facial detail. No brand badges, café typography, license-plate text, logos, or readable signs.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, speeding, stunt, unsafe riding, helmetless traffic riding, explicit, nsfw, logo, license plate, readable text, watermark, distorted motorcycle, malformed hands, extra limbs, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional identity references must show a consenting adult. Vehicle and environment references are replaceable and must have all badges, plates, names, and copy removed.
